dict.Categoriile: A sunt clienții mari sau cu: Categories: A are large customers or those with a contract, B those who buy often, C the rest (list price). You change the discounts in the yellow boxes.
dict.Prețul de achiziție nu se trimite clienț: The purchase price is not sent to customers: before sending the list, hide column K or delete it from a copy.
dict.Prețul de listă fără și cu TVA și prețur: The list price without and with VAT and the discounted prices for customers A, B and C (you choose the discounts once, on the right); from the purchase price, the status shows the products sold below cost to customers A (yellow) or to everyone (red).
dict.Prețurile de listă le poți lua din Sheet: You can take the list prices from Sheets → Selling price calculation; a price change is announced in advance to customers with a contract.
